The institutional investor held 15,435 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $591,000, up from 6,407 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Raab & Moskowitz Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Cisco Sys Inc Com for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $208.41 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.71% or $0.31 during the last trading session, reaching $43.26. About 13.73 million shares traded. Cisco Systems, Inc. (NASDAQ:CSCO) has risen 25.57% since May 26, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 14.02% the S&P500.
